fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Sarjana Sains Teknologi Maklumat (Masters of Science in Information Technology) (programme code mt23), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20250219104549): RM15,460 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation.
